import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_MOD_N = 1024000;
    static Mod[] fact = new Mod[MAX_MOD_N];
    static Mod[] factinv = new Mod[MAX_MOD_N];
    static Map<Integer, Integer> mp = new HashMap<>();

    static class Mod {
        int num;

        Mod() {
            this(0);
        }

        Mod(long n) {
            num = (int) ((n % MOD + MOD) % MOD);
        }

        Mod(int n) {
            this((long) n);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(num);
        }
    }

    static Mod add(Mod a, Mod b) {
        return new Mod((a.num + b.num) % MOD);
    }

    static Mod add(long a, Mod b) {
        return add(new Mod(a), b);
    }

    static Mod add(Mod a, long b) {
        return add(b, a);
    }

    static Mod inc(Mod a) {
        return add(a, new Mod(1));
    }

    static Mod sub(Mod a, Mod b) {
        return new Mod((MOD + a.num - b.num) % MOD);
    }

    static Mod sub(long a, Mod b) {
        return sub(new Mod(a), b);
    }

    static Mod dec(Mod a) {
        return sub(a, new Mod(1));
    }

    static Mod mul(Mod a, Mod b) {
        return new Mod(((long) a.num * b.num) % MOD);
    }

    static Mod mul(long a, Mod b) {
        return mul(new Mod(a), b);
    }

    static Mod mul(Mod a, long b) {
        return mul(b, a);
    }

    static Mod mul(Mod a, int b) {
        return mul(new Mod(b), a);
    }

    static Mod pow(Mod a, int n) {
        if (n == 0) return new Mod(1);
        Mod res = pow(mul(a, a), n / 2);
        if (n % 2 == 1) res = mul(res, a);
        return res;
    }

    static Mod inv(Mod a) {
        return pow(a, MOD - 2);
    }

    static Mod div(Mod a, Mod b) {
        return mul(a, inv(b));
    }

    static Mod div(long a, Mod b) {
        return div(new Mod(a), b);
    }

    static void init() {
        fact[0] = new Mod(1);
        factinv[0] = new Mod(1);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_MOD_N - 1; ++i) {
            fact[i + 1] = mul(fact[i], new Mod(i + 1));
            factinv[i + 1] = div(factinv[i], new Mod(i + 1));
        }
    }

    static Mod comb(int a, int b) {
        return mul(mul(fact[a], factinv[b]), factinv[a - b]);
    }

    static void initPers(List<List<Mod>> pers) {
        List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) v.add(0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) v.add(1);

        Collections.sort(v);
        int id = 0;
        do {
            int tt = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) {
                if (v.get(k) != 0) tt ^= (1 << k);
            }
            mp.put(tt, id);
            id++;
        } while (nextPermutation(v));

        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int s = 3 - (N + 1) / 2;

        for (int i = 0; i < s; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                if (i == j) {
                    pers.get(i).set(j, new Mod(1));
                } else {
                    pers.get(i).set(j, new Mod(0));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = s; i < s + N; ++i) {
            for (int j = s; j < s + N; ++j) {
                int p = sc.nextInt();
                pers.get(i).set(j, div(new Mod(p), new Mod(100)));
            }
        }

        for (int i = s + N; i < 6; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                if (i == j) {
                    pers.get(i).set(j, new Mod(1));
                } else {
                    pers.get(i).set(j, new Mod(0));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> v) {
        int i = v.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && v.get(i) >= v.get(i + 1)) --i;
        if (i < 0) return false;

        int j = v.size() - 1;
        while (v.get(j) <= v.get(i)) --j;
        Collections.swap(v, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(v.subList(i + 1, v.size()));
        return true;
    }

    static List<Mod> solve(List<List<Mod>> pers, int al) {
        List<Mod> l_nums = new ArrayList<>(1 << 20);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); ++i) {
            l_nums.add(new Mod(0));
        }

        for (int xx = 0; xx < (1 << 18); ++xx) {
            List<List<Integer>> haves = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
                haves.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(6, 0)));
            }

            Mod per = new Mod(1);
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                    int k = i * 6 + j;
                    if ((xx & (1 << k)) != 0) {
                        haves.get(i).set(j, 1);
                        per = mul(per, pers.get(al + i).get(j));
                    } else {
                        per = mul(per, sub(new Mod(1), pers.get(al + i).get(j)));
                    }
                }
            }

            int flags = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
                if (haves.get(0).get(i) == 0) continue;
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                    if (haves.get(1).get(j) == 0) continue;
                    if (i == j) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) {
                        if (haves.get(2).get(k) == 0) continue;
                        if (i == k) continue;
                        if (j == k) continue;
                        else {
                            int anum = 0;
                            anum ^= (1 << i);
                            anum ^= (1 << j);
                            anum ^= (1 << k);
                            flags |= (1 << mp.get(anum));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            int idx = flags;
            Mod val = l_nums.get(idx);
            l_nums.set(idx, add(val, per));
        }
        return l_nums;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        List<List<Mod>> pers = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
            List<Mod> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                row.add(new Mod(0));
            }
            pers.add(row);
        }

        init();
        initPers(pers);

        List<Mod> u_nums = solve(pers, 0);
        List<Mod> d_nums = solve(pers, 3);

        for (int x = 1; x < (1 << 20); x <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); ++i) {
                if ((i & x) == 0) {
                    int idx = i ^ x;
                    Mod val = add(d_nums.get(idx), d_nums.get(i));
                    d_nums.set(idx, val);
                }
            }
        }

        Mod answer = new Mod(0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); ++i) {
            if (u_nums.get(i).num != 0) {
                int need = 0;
                for (int x = 0; x < 20; ++x) {
                    if ((i & (1 << x)) != 0) {
                        need |= (1 << (19 - x));
                    }
                }
                int pp = ((1 << 20) - 1) ^ i;
                Mod complement = d_nums.get(((1 << 20) - 1) ^ need);
                Mod one = new Mod(1);
                Mod nanswer = mul(u_nums.get(i), sub(one, complement));
                answer = add(answer, nanswer);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer.num);
    }
}
